products.title: QwikMart - All-in-One Quick Commerce & eCommerce Platform with Multi-Store & Multi-Country
products.shortDescription: Launch 10-minute grocery delivery and a full online store from one platform — Flutter customer & rider apps, Next.js website and Admin, Store & Rider panels on a serverless Firebase backend.
products.fullDescription:
QwikMart is a multi-store Quick Commerce and eCommerce solution for launching, managing and scaling All-in-One grocery, retail, pharmacy and marketplace businesses from one system. Customers order daily essentials for delivery in minutes from the nearest store, or shop a wider catalogue delivered in 1–4 days — in the same app, with one toggle.

The platform includes a Flutter Customer App and Delivery Boy App (Android & iOS), a Next.js customer website and three web panels — Super Admin, Store and Delivery Boy — all running on Google Firebase. There is no PHP, MySQL, cron job or VPS to maintain: Cloud Functions, Firestore and App Hosting scale automatically and you pay only for what you use.

Draw delivery zones on a map, assign stores, design the home screen per zone, take payments with native Razorpay checkout, track riders live on the map and verify every hand-over with a delivery OTP. Wallet, refunds, Refer & Earn, coupons, returns, support chat and AI-generated product content are built in.

products.title: Go4Market - Multi-Vendor Quick Commerce & eCommerce Platform with Grocery, Food, Pharmacy & Shopping
products.shortDescription: Launch a multi-vendor marketplace for groceries, food, medicines and shopping with 15/30-minute delivery — Flutter Customer & Partner apps, a Flutter Web storefront and Admin, Seller & Delivery panels on a serverless Firebase backend.
products.fullDescription:
Go4Market is a multi-vendor quick commerce and eCommerce platform that brings four businesses into one marketplace: Grocery, Food, Pharmacy and Shopping. Local sellers list their products, customers order from one cart, and orders arrive in 15 or 30 minutes, in a scheduled slot or ready for self-pickup at the store.

The package includes two Flutter mobile apps — the Customer App and the Partner App, where sellers and delivery partners pick their role at sign-up — plus a Flutter Web customer website and Flutter Web Admin, Seller and Delivery panels. Everything runs on Google Firebase: Cloud Functions (TypeScript), Cloud Firestore, Authentication, Storage and Cloud Messaging. There is no PHP, MySQL, VPS or cron job to maintain.

Prices, coupons, wallet, stock and payments are calculated on the server. Riders are tracked live on OpenStreetMap, every hand-over is verified with a delivery OTP, and COD cash, seller commissions, rider earnings, withdrawals, fund transfers and salaries are settled automatically. Sellers also get a POS with barcode scanning for walk-in customers.

products.title: Go4Foodie - All-in-One Restaurant POS, QR Table Ordering & Online Food Ordering Platform on Firebase
products.tagline: All-in-One Restaurant POS, QR Ordering & Online Food Ordering
products.shortDescription: Run dine-in, QR table ordering, take-away and reservations from one platform — a live floor plan and table POS, a Next.js ordering website, a Flutter app with Customer, Restaurant and Owner modes, and a Flutter Web admin panel on a serverless Firebase backend.
products.fullDescription:
Go4Foodie is an all-in-one restaurant platform for dine-in, QR table ordering, take-away and reservations. Guests order on the website or by scanning the QR code on their table, staff run the floor and the bill from a live POS, and owners follow revenue, tables and team from anywhere — all on one menu, one set of tables and one order history.

The package includes a Next.js customer website, a Flutter Web Admin Panel, and one Flutter mobile app (Android & iOS) with three modes chosen on the first screen: Customer App, Restaurant App for waiters and cashiers, and Owner App. Everything runs on Google Firebase — one Cloud Function API, Cloud Firestore, Authentication, Storage, Hosting and App Hosting — so there is no VPS, PHP, MySQL or cron job to maintain.

Open a table, send items to the kitchen with a printed KOT, void, add discount, tax, service and tip, split the payment across cash, card and UPI, merge tables and close the bill — the floor updates live for everyone. Online payments with Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal, gift cards and coupons, branded e-mails, inventory alerts, table analytics, reports and an audit log are built in.

products.name: Go4Ride
products.title: Go4Ride - Taxi Booking, Ride Hailing, Intercity, Rental & Parcel Platform with Driver App and Admin Panel on Firebase
products.tagline: Taxi, Intercity, Rental & Parcel Booking — Customer App, Driver App & Admin Panel
products.shortDescription: Launch your own ride-hailing business: a Flutter Customer App for cab, intercity, rental and parcel bookings, a Flutter Driver App with KYC, live location, OTP-verified trips and earnings, and a premium Flutter Web Admin Panel — all on a serverless Firebase backend with Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, cash and wallet payments.
products.fullDescription:
Go4Ride is a complete ride-hailing platform for taxi operators, fleet owners and agencies. Riders book a city cab, an intercity seat or a private intercity trip, rent a car by the hour or send a parcel; nearby approved drivers get the request instantly, the rider follows the driver live on the map and the trip starts only after the rider's 4-digit OTP is verified.

The package includes two Flutter mobile apps (Android & iOS) — the Customer App and the Driver App — and a premium black-and-white Flutter Web Admin Panel with light and dark mode. Everything runs on Google Firebase: Authentication with phone OTP, Cloud Firestore, the Realtime Database for live driver locations, Cloud Storage, Cloud Messaging and Cloud Functions. There is no VPS, PHP, MySQL or cron job to maintain.

Money is handled on the server. Commission is booked once per completed trip, cash trips deduct the commission from the driver wallet, wallet and online trips credit the driver's share, late cancellations charge a fee to the rider and pay it to the driver, and every online payment through Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal is verified with the gateway before the trip is marked paid or the wallet is credited.

products.title: ClassiAds-Hub - Classified Ads & Buy-Sell Marketplace with Flutter App, Next.js Website and Admin Panel on Firebase
products.tagline: Classified Ads & Buy-Sell Marketplace — Website, Mobile App & Admin Panel
products.shortDescription: Launch your own OLX-style marketplace: a Next.js website and a Flutter app where people post ads with photos and category fields, search and filter, chat and make offers, and a Next.js Admin Panel to moderate ads, manage categories, content, sellers and packages — all on a serverless Firebase backend with Stripe, Razorpay and PayPal checkout on the website.
products.fullDescription:
ClassiAds-Hub is a complete classified ads and buy-sell marketplace for any city, country or niche — cars, phones, property, electronics, jobs and anything else. Sellers post an ad with photos, price, location and category-specific details; buyers search, filter, save favourites, chat with the seller and make price offers; and when the item is sold the buyer can rate the seller.

The package includes a Next.js website, a Flutter app for Android and iOS and a Next.js Admin Panel. Everything runs on Google Firebase: a Cloud Functions REST API, Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication (email, phone and Google), Cloud Storage, Cloud Messaging and Firebase Hosting. There is no VPS, PHP, MySQL or cron job to maintain.

Your team runs the marketplace from the Admin Panel: approve or reject ads, build unlimited nested categories with custom fields, manage sliders, feature sections and blog content, verify sellers, handle reviews and reports, and sell posting packages and featured-ad plans on the website through Stripe, Razorpay or PayPal hosted checkout that is verified on the server.
